name: GAMUDA
recent: Gamuda 近期在澳大利亚和越南推进多项工程与房地产开发项目，包括 Sydney Metro West 的 Bays West 车站工程及 Hanoi 的 Central Park 项目。同时，公司因 ESOS 行使持续发行新股，EPF 亦多次申报持股变动。
notable: Gamuda 在 Sydney Metro West 的 Bays West 车站工程已启动。
Gamuda Land 在 Hanoi 正式推出 Central Park 项目，涉及超过 2,600 个公寓单位。
Gamuda 因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股，最新一批新股将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日上市。
risks: 集团首席财务官 Soo Kok Wong 于 2026 年 11 月 11 日以每股 RM4.90 出售 383,800 股普通股。
多名董事及高管在封闭期内表示有意进行证券交易。
EPF 在 2026 年 11 月多次申报持股变动，显示大股东持股持续调整。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 7 月 31 日）营收为 MYR 5,757,011,000，净利为 MYR 349,701,000，净利率 6.1%。营收环比增长 29.8%，净利环比增长 35.6%；营收同比增长 18.9%，净利同比增长 5.3%。

recent_en: Gamuda has recently progressed several engineering and property development projects in Australia and Vietnam, including the Bays West station works for Sydney Metro West and the Central Park project in Hanoi. Meanwhile, the company continues to issue new shares from ESOS exercises, and EPF has made multiple shareholding change filings.
notable_en: Gamuda has started works on the Bays West station on Sydney Metro West.
Gamuda Land officially launched the Central Park project in Hanoi, comprising over 2,600 apartment units.
Gamuda has issued new shares multiple times from ESOS exercises, with the latest batch to be listed on 27 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Group Chief Financial Officer Soo Kok Wong disposed of 383,800 ordinary shares at RM4.90 per share on 11 Nov 2026.
Several directors and senior management have indicated intentions to deal in securities during the closed period.
EPF made multiple shareholding change filings in November 2026, indicating ongoing adjustments by a substantial shareholder.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 31 July), revenue was MYR 5,757,011,000 and net income was MYR 349,701,000, with a net margin of 6.1%. Revenue rose 29.8% QoQ and net income rose 35.6% QoQ; revenue grew 18.9% YoY and net income grew 5.3% YoY.
